lore9564_greet_1.ogg.spoken: [showmanlike] [friendly] A special announcement! My friend has arrived, and for once there is no hurry to send the passenger somewhere else. Come along. I would like to hear what you have been doing.
lore9564_greet_1.ogg.text: A special announcement! My friend has arrived, and for once there is no hurry to send the passenger somewhere else. Come along. I would like to hear what you have been doing.

lore9564_idle_1.ogg.spoken: [playful] [grandly amused] A brief and magnificent pause is now beginning. Refreshments are whatever I remembered to bring. You may applaud, but please do not ask for the departure time of my lunch.
lore9564_idle_1.ogg.text: A brief and magnificent pause is now beginning. Refreshments are whatever I remembered to bring. You may applaud, but please do not ask for the departure time of my lunch.

lore9564_taxi_1.ogg.spoken: [enthusiastic] [pleased] And we are away! A fine journey, a promising view, and someone else handling the departure. I shall make the most of being the passenger for a little while.
lore9564_taxi_1.ogg.text: And we are away! A fine journey, a promising view, and someone else handling the departure. I shall make the most of being the passenger for a little while.
